title: Errors
instructions: Reminder: a syntax error prevents the game from building. A logic error builds and runs but does the wrong thing. A runtime error crashes while the game is running.

prompts.question: You forgot a semicolon and the game will not build.
The player's health goes up when they take damage.
The game crashes when it tries to divide the score by zero.
A door opens at 2 keys instead of 3, but the game does not crash.
The compiler reports an error for if (health = 0) before the game builds.
The game crashes when code reads inventory slot 8 even though there are only 5 slots.
